jobs.title: Trust Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd_full:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As part of the trust team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline trust workflows, enhance decision-making around risk, and support responsible growth. The team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners — including Product, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Engineering — to drive accountability, insights, and operational integrity across the business.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • End-to-End Process Management — Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support trust and safety functions, promoting consistency and adoption across the org.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with Engineering and Growth teams to drive initiatives that enhance trust infrastructure and operational effectiveness.

  • Leadership Partnership — Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership, delivering strategic insights, risk reporting, and actionable recommendations.

  • Data-Driven Strategy — Oversee analytics across trust functions. Identify risk patterns and areas for improvement; build dashboards and insights that inform policy decisions and guide operational improvements.

  • Reporting & Analytics — Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and KPIs that measure trust and safety performance and impact.

Who you are

  • Passionate about responsible AI and motivated by building systems that protect users and maintain platform integrity

  • Highly motivated with a strong work ethic — you understand the stakes of this moment in AI and are committed to getting it right

  • Analytical and first-principles oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex risk tradeoffs

  • Consistently deliver high-quality work quickly and take initiative from day one

  • Low ego, high ownership

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex risk data into clear recommendations

  • 4+ years in Security, Trust & Safety Operations, or Risk Operations at a high-growth technology company

  • Proven track record building end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis through to execution

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Policy, Legal, or Safety teams

  • Highly adaptable with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe. Preference for candidates based in London.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is hiring exceptional Revenue Operations analysts who will support a team of experts growing and managing our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. The Revenue Operations teams drive continuous policy, process and data quality improvement which enable us to analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.

You will support the leadership of the team, providing insights to drive improvements and partnering with Canonical’s teams across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal. This position requires an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the desire to strive for excellence. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about collaborating with sales and business development teams, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and contributing to initiatives in support of Canonical's continued success. Successful candidates will demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.

Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions

The role entails

  • Supporting all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales and business development functions globally
  • Driving data quality, through checking opportunities for accuracy, clean order processing, new hire training, policy and process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
  • Supporting and enabling the sales team globally on CRM and other revenue operations policies, processes and systems such as Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement, Data Enrichment, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
  • Supporting other Revenue Operations Analysts and leadership team to report on and improve data quality, sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks.
  • Supporting planning, monitoring and improving revenue operations, across new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals. Delivering insight that enables improved territory and quota management, channel development and sales productivity.
  • Assisting the team with automation and streamlining of the end-to-end Lead to Order process

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Experience working as an analyst in revenue/sales operations or related fields such as financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent attention to detail and data-driven, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Planning and organisational skills, including the ability to interact and work with stakeholders across functions and at all levels of the organisation
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills, including comfort working with teams under commercial pressure
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
  • Understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including within a team based remotely in multiple time zones

What Canonical offers

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

#LI-remote

jobs.title: Company Operations Lead
jobs.jd_full:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

About the role

The FT app is an important part of how subscribers engage with FT journalism, and we believe there is a significant opportunity to go further. We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager with a strong background in native and/or cross-platform mobile apps to play a central role in this transformation.

You’ll join at a pivotal moment, working alongside our Principal Product Manager, engineering and design colleagues to turn our app strategy into reality, delivering improvements to the app experience and building the capabilities that will support its continued evolution.

This is an opportunity to shape a product used by a highly engaged global audience, while helping establish a stronger mobile product discipline within the FT.

What you’ll be doing

Help shape the future of the FT app

  • Work with the Principal Product Manager to translate our long-term app strategy into clear product requirements, priorities and a deliverable roadmap.
  • Bring specialist mobile product knowledge and experience to decisions about the future app experience, challenging assumptions and finding opportunities to make better use of native device capabilities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their behaviours and the moments in which they turn to the FT, using research, analytics and experimentation to see opportunities.
  • Champion a mobile-first approach to product development, ensuring we’re designing around the needs of app customers and complementing their web experience.
  • Work across product teams to ensure the app delivers a coherent, premium experience that delivers meaningful value for the business, while making effective use of shared FT capabilities.

Deliver a distinctive, premium mobile experience

  • Own and prioritise defined areas of the app roadmap, balancing customer value, strategic impact, technical dependencies and commercial outcomes.
  • Work day-to-day with engineering, design, data and editorial colleagues to take initiatives from discovery through development, release and iteration.
  • Help deliver experiences that make the FT more essential to customers’ daily routines, including better navigation, discovery, personalisation, notifications, offline experiences and continuity across devices.
  • Explore opportunities to make FT journalism more engaging and useful through native mobile interactions and seamless experiences across text, audio, video, data and other formats.
  • Collaborate with teams responsible for identity, subscriptions and customer lifecycle to make the app a more effective platform for acquisition, engagement, retention and subscriber growth.
  • Establish clear success measures, use experimentation and customer feedback to inform decisions, and continuously optimise the experience.
  • Ensure that performance, accessibility, reliability and usability are treated as fundamental parts of the product experience.

Build mobile product expertise within the FT

  • Act as a source of specialist mobile product knowledge for colleagues across product, design and engineering.
  • Share best practices in app product management, including platform conventions, app store requirements, release management, mobile analytics and experimentation.
  • Help establish effective ways of working for developing and maintaining high-quality iOS and Android experiences.
  • Stay informed about developments in mobile technology, customer expectations and emerging product capabilities, identifying opportunities relevant to the FT.

About you

Essential experience and skills

  • Proven mobile app product management experience: You have owned and delivered meaningful improvements to consumer-facing iOS and/or Android apps, ideally within products with significant scale, frequent usage or complex customer journeys.
  • Understanding of mobile technologies: You have practical experience working with native and/or cross-platform development teams and understand the differences, opportunities and trade-offs between architectures. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you can engage in technical discussions and understand the product implications of architectural decisions.
  • Knowledge of the mobile ecosystem: You’re familiar with Apple and Google’s platform conventions, app store policies, submission and release processes, in-app purchases, push notifications, device capabilities and the considerations involved in delivering consistently high-quality app experiences.
  • Strong product management fundamentals: You’re experienced in customer discovery, defining problems and opportunities, prioritisation, roadmap management, experimentation and measuring product outcomes.
  • Proven delivery experience: You’ve worked closely with cross-functional engineering and design teams to deliver products iteratively, navigate technical complexity and balance short-term improvements with longer-term investment.
  • Customer and commercial focus: You use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand customer needs, make decisions and evaluate success. You understand how product experience contributes to engagement, retention and commercial performance.
  • Collaborative and influential: You’re comfortable working across organisational boundaries, bringing different disciplines together and influencing decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You can operate effectively while technology choices, team structures and delivery approaches are evolving, helping turn strategic ambition into practical action.

Desirable experience

  • Experience working on subscription-based digital products, particularly in publishing, media, content or other habit-forming consumer services.
  • Experience developing products that combine native and web-based capabilities.
  • Experience with personalisation, content discovery, notifications, offline functionality or other features that drive regular app engagement.
  • Experience working with external development partners while retaining internal product ownership.
  • Experience helping organisations establish or mature their mobile product development practices.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available on the FT Careers website.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of the team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
POSITION SUMMARY

As part of the Software Product Management team, the Sr Product Manager will help achieve Natera’s strategic imperatives through excellence in technology.

They will work on a suite of products that are critical to lab operations, R&D, process development, customer support, commercial operations, genetic counseling, reporting, bioinformatics, statistics, and more. They will need to deeply understand the end-to-end workflow and the technical details of the software systems to deliver our best in class personalized genetic tests.

They will use this knowledge to translate and document detailed use cases and product requirements. The Sr. Product Manager must be able to drive prioritization and critical decision-making on solutions.

FOCUS AREA

This position will be a key contributor and driver of the core software product roadmap. The role focuses on our end-to-end software stack to support and scale various on market product lines. This will include enhancing the product’s market impact, user experience, and operational efficiency by identifying new opportunities, gathering cross-functional input, and translating user needs into actionable features. This role requires a strong blend of strategic thinking, technical acumen, and a passion for driving innovation and delivering high-quality digital solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You are passionate about designing and building a better world for patients and clinicians. You are mission driven. You thrive in ambiguous, chaotic situations. You have a fearless bias towards action that is data-driven, purposeful, and focused. You are excited by the prospect of rolling up your sleeves to tackle meaningful problems each and every day. You’re a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who seeks and gives candid feedback.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Immerse yourself in the tough problems we’re solving, and team with R&D, designers, engineers, clinical product managers, and operations to develop elegant software solutions to solve those problems.
  • Develop the product strategy and roadmap for your product line.
  • Communicate with senior-level stakeholders to champion your roadmap and gain buy-in for product plans
  • Transform business, market and clinical requirements into executable product requirements
  • Own and prioritize a feature backlog to align with the overall strategic roadmap.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on our software products and create a shared understanding among business and technical teams.
  • Produce deliverables that facilitate better understanding for feedback such as flow diagrams, data models, pros/cons, prototypes, wireframes and other illustrations.
  • Define what success looks like for your product and measure it.
  • Monitor industry trends and competitive landscape to ensure you know what makes a best-in-class user experience for your product line.
  • Incorporate a focus on quality into product design and work closely with development and software quality assurance teams on product and process improvements.
  • Solicit user feedback and funnel new requirements and product changes back into software development.
  • Evangelize your products across the organization, drive integration and ensure desired positive impact is achieved. Have a sense of ownership for everything you engage in.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience in software product management, ideally in the healthcare IT or biotech industry.
  • Extensive experience in conceptualizing, defining and creating best in class software experiences
  • Experience with Agile software development, building solutions from start to finish.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship-building, and analytical skills
  • Experience with implementing scalable and sophisticated business rule applications.
  • Experience building enterprise software or business critical systems is a plus.
  • A proven track record of cross-functional leadership.
  • Well developed systems thinking
  • BA/BS degree in relevant technical, scientific, or quantitative discipline or relevant experience.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Customer research and survey skills – how to ask good questions, listen carefully, and synthesize information into clear customer and business needs.
  • Highly organized with ability to multitask.
  • Ability to collaborate and interact effectively with individuals, and influence individuals across functional areas and in team environments.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of products and markets, or ability to learn quickly.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to understand and describe technical complexities in a simplified way appropriate to different audiences
  • Be able to break down large projects into granular milestones and track progress.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$120,100—$150,100 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager I
jobs.jd_full:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Location: Remote within the United States

Travel: 30-50% (domestic) - onsite with Enterprise customers

Reports to: Sr Director of Professional Service, Enterprise

As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Axon, you will lead the delivery of complex, enterprise-scale deployments for our Strategic Enterprise customers that operate around the globe. You’ll own programs end-to-end—partnering with customers, product, engineering, and delivery teams to translate complex requirements into clear plans and successful outcomes.

This role operates in high-visibility, mission-critical environments where priorities evolve and judgment matters. You’ll bring structure to ambiguity, maintain composure under pressure, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders—balancing customer needs, product capabilities, and long-term scalability.

Success in this role comes from a strong sense of ownership, disciplined execution, and a genuine connection to Axon’s mission to protect life. If you thrive on solving complex problems at scale and delivering technology that makes a real-world impact, this role is for you.

Axon’s Enterprise customers depend on technology that works in high-stakes, real-world environments. This role ensures complex, multi-product deployments are delivered reliably, adopted successfully, and scaled with confidence.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you sit at the intersection of customer trust, execution, and mission impact—turning complexity into clarity and ensuring Axon’s technology delivers when it matters most.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex, enterprise-scale programs for Strategic and Global customers, driving execution from planning through deployment, acceptance, and adoption.
  • Lead multiple high-impact programs simultaneously, maintaining disciplined control over scope, timeline, dependencies, and risk in dynamic environments.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer and regulatory requirements into executable delivery plans, making informed tradeoffs when constraints arise.
  • Serve as a trusted program lead for customers and internal stakeholders—bringing clarity, confidence, and calm leadership in high-stakes situations.
  • Drive alignment across Sales, PSO, Engineering, Product, and external partners, ensuring teams are focused on the work that matters most.
  • Anticipate risks and constraints early, surface them clearly, and act decisively to mitigate issues before they impact delivery or customer trust.
  • Lead program-level change management, adapting plans as requirements evolve while maintaining momentum and accountability.
  • Communicate complex technical and operational topics with precision—tailoring messaging for executive, technical, and frontline audiences.
  • Champion continuous improvement by identifying delivery gaps, refining processes, and helping scale repeatable, enterprise-ready execution models.
  • Contribute to a team-first culture by mentoring peers, sharing lessons learned, and raising the bar for program execution across the organization.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • 10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in enterprise SaaS, hardware-enabled platforms, or mission-critical environments.
  • Proven track record delivering large-scale, multi-stakeholder deployments for enterprise or global customers.
  • Program management fundamentals, including scope, schedule, risk, dependency, and change management.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services to drive aligned execution.

jobs.title: AMER Data Analyst - Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business.

Responsibilities

  • Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews).
  • Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making.
  • Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management).
  • Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development.
  • Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains.
  • Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems.
  • User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways.
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level.
  • Ability to communicate technical content to non-technical audiences and translate business insights into practical recommendations, with a willingness to grow into presenting to leadership.
  • Experience initiating and completing analytical projects, taking a structured approach to solving unique business problems.
  • Experience in Salesforce (or other CRM). Intermediate to advanced SQL and strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills.
  • Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to creatively solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis in a fast-paced, high-volume business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve analytical and operational workflows.

jobs.title: Partner Delivery Manager, Air & Space Delivery Team
jobs.jd_full:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.

About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

Air Force and Space Force organizations need planning tools that fit the way their staffs make decisions, coordinate across commands, and execute missions. A successful implementation depends on more than a software rollout: it requires someone who understands air and space operations, can earn the trust of planners, and can translate their workflows into practical, sustained use.

As a Partner Delivery Manager, you will onboard new commands, help existing customers realize sustained operational value, and support qualified growth opportunities. You will bring Air and Space expertise to exercises, customer workflows, demonstrations, and pilots while making each delivery more repeatable. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Air & Space Delivery Operations Manager.

What You’ll Do

  • Own assigned new-command onboarding from the Growth handoff through a conditions-based transition to Mission Success. Define customer outcomes, coordinate delivery, and surface risks early.

  • Help air and space planners translate operational processes into useful Onebrief workflows; train and coach users in person and remotely. Validate Space Force use cases on their own merits rather than assuming Air Force workflows transfer directly.

  • Support existing customers alongside Mission Success through exercises, planning events, workflow improvements, training, and coordinated issue resolution so they realize sustained operational value.

  • Partner with Growth and Mission Success on scoped demonstrations, pilots, and net-new and expansion opportunities. Define the customer problem, required resources, success criteria, and next decision.

  • Build proficiency in Onebrief and Onebrief AI, and provide basic Atom Engine support in partnership with the Atom Engine Delivery Team.

  • Share customer needs, product feedback, and after-action lessons with the appropriate teams; turn validated insights into reusable workflows, demonstration assets, and delivery playbooks.

  • Remain comfortable and ready to pivot beyond your primary customer base to support other customers, delivery teams, and surge requirements as GDT priorities evolve.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience supporting operational planning, coordination, or execution in an Air Force or Space Force headquarters, operations center, wing, or comparable joint environment.

  • Working knowledge of air or space planning and the ability to explain how staff organizations, operational workflows, and decision makers interact.

  • Experience independently coordinating a complex onboarding, implementation, exercise, or operational event across multiple stakeholders.

  • Ability to build trust with customers, teach new tools and workflows, and communicate clearly with operational and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn complex software, troubleshoot initial issues, and coordinate resolution. Experience implementing software or leading change across classified and unclassified environments.

  • Current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI, ability to access DoD facilities, and readiness to travel more than 50% of the time, both within the continental United States and internationally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in an air operations center, the Joint Planning Process for Air, or the Air Tasking Cycle and its associated systems and outputs.

  • Experience supporting Space Force mission planning, space operations centers or the integration of space capabilities into joint or combined operational planning.

  • Experience with modeling, simulation, wargaming, or operational demonstrations for air or space customers.

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, operational planning, analysis, or customer delivery. Familiarity with effective prompt engineering, critically evaluating AI-generated outputs, and leveraging AI Agents or automation to streamline repeatable workflows and improve execution.

Indicators of Success

Customer needs and priorities evolve, and success in this role requires adaptability and resilience. The outcomes below illustrate what success typically looks like approximately six months into the role:

  • Assigned onboarding and delivery commitments meet customer-agreed outcomes, with risks surfaced early and a clear handoff to Mission Success.

  • Existing customers receive effective exercise, planning, or workflow support that helps them realize operational value.

  • Scoped demonstrations, pilots, or expansion engagements contribute to clear customer decisions, and internal partners receive actionable customer feedback.

  • Validated lessons or assets are reused by the team, reducing preparation effort or time-to-value for a comparable engagement.

Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Motley Fool Asset Management
jobs.jd_full:
Who are we?

Motley Fool Asset Management (MFAM) brings The Motley Fool’s decades of investing expertise to professionally managed ETFs, helping investors put our long-term, high-conviction investing philosophy to work without having to manage individual stocks themselves. As a growing business within The Motley Fool, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of a scaling asset manager with the strength of a trusted financial brand.

We’re passionate about thoughtful investing, continuous improvement, and delivering an exceptional experience for our clients- and we’re looking for people who are excited to help shape what’s next.

What would you do in this role?

We are seeking an experienced, organized Project Manager to work across the entire company, giving every team a shared view of what is in flight, what is due, and what is blocked. You will be the owner of our project portfolio in Jira, building the structure, cadence, and reporting that keep teams aligned and deliverables on schedule. This is a hands-on role that calls for someone who knows Jira inside and out and who understands how an asset manager operates.

But what does this role actually do?

  1. Project Management:

    • Track and manage company-wide projects from initiation to completion using Jira.
    • Coordinate with team leads across portfolio management, trading, operations, compliance, legal, marketing and tech to ensure milestones are met.
    • Monitor timelines and adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or delays.

  2. Dependency and Blocker Management:

    • Identify cross-team dependencies early and make sure each team knows what it owns, what is due, and what it is blocking.
    • Escalate blockers to leadership before they cause delays.
    • Maintain a clear view of risks, issues, and team capacity.

  3. Jira Administration and Automation:

    • Design and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, filters, and dashboards that fit how the firm works.
    • Set up automation rules and intake forms for status notifications, overdue reminders, and new project requests.
    • Keep Jira data accurate and consistent so it serves as the single source of truth.

  4. Documentation and Reporting:

    • Maintain up-to-date project documentation, including runbooks and process guides.
    • Deliver a consistent weekly view of portfolio health, timelines, and risks to leadership.

  5. Continuous Improvement:

    • Identify opportunities to streamline how projects are taken, prioritized, and tracked.
    • Recommend and implement lightweight best practices.

What do you need to apply?

  • 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably in asset management, ETFs, or financial services.
  • Expert-level Jira experience, including administration, workflows, dashboards, and automation.
  • Working knowledge of the ETF lifecycle and the functions around it (portfolio management, trading, operations, compliance, distribution) is strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and levels of seniority.
  • Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

We estimate the above services & deliverables to take no more than 20-25 hours a week.

Hourly Pay Range

$65—$75 USD

By applying on this site, you acknowledge that The Motley Fool will be collecting the personal data you provide for our recruiting purposes. Please see our Applicant Privacy Notice for additional information about how we process, transfer, and store your data, including where that data is stored, and about any additional privacy rights you may have based on your jurisdiction.

jobs.title: Remote Project Manager-Structural & Miscellaneous Steel
jobs.jd_full:
About the Company

Our client is an established structural and miscellaneous steel contractor delivering projects throughout the Southwestern United States. The company provides comprehensive steel solutions, coordinating preconstruction, detailing, fabrication, and erection while supporting design-assist and design-build project delivery.

With an integrated approach to project execution and a collaborative team spanning multiple disciplines, the organization is committed to delivering quality steel packages while maintaining strong relationships with clients, general contractors, and project partners.

About the Position

Our client is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Structural & Miscellaneous Steel to take ownership of projects from detailing through fabrication, erection, and final closeout. This remote opportunity is ideal for a steel project management professional who understands the complete structural steel lifecycle and how drawing releases, fabrication schedules, material procurement, and erection sequencing impact overall project performance.

Reporting to the Director of Project Management, the Project Manager will oversee project schedules, budgets, contract administration, client relationships, and execution. This individual will work closely with dedicated preconstruction, detailing, fabrication, purchasing, safety, and project administration teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and profitably.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and general contractors following preconstruction turnover.
  • Coordinate engineering, design teams, and detailing personnel to manage drawing releases, model reviews, RFIs, and submittals.
  • Align material procurement, fabrication releases, deliveries, and erection sequencing with project schedules.
  • Direct and support assigned Assistant Project Managers and project coordinators.
  • Coordinate vendors, sub-fabricators, and erection subcontractors throughout project execution.
  • Manage project scope changes, subcontract agreements, purchase orders, and contract administration.
  • Develop monthly cost forecasts, oversee progress billing, and manage project cash flow.
  • Monitor project schedules, budgets, and overall performance to identify and resolve potential issues.
  • Coordinate field issue resolution with erection teams, safety personnel, and quality teams.
  • Participate in project meetings and jobsite visits to maintain alignment and address project needs.
  • Maintain project documentation and document control through Procore.
  • Drive final billing, retention release, and project closeout activities.

Work Arrangement & Travel:

This is a remote position with project-related travel throughout the Western United States. Candidates located in California, Arizona, New Mexico, Utah, Colorado, or Nevada are preferred, although surrounding states may also be considered. Travel requirements vary by project and may include overnight trips or weekly jobsite visits during active erection phases.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience managing structural and miscellaneous steel projects.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Project Manager or Assistant Project Manager within the structural steel industry.
  • Strong understanding of the full structural steel project lifecycle, including detailing, fabrication, procurement, delivery, and erection.
  • Experience with design-assist and design-build project delivery preferred.
  • Structural steel detailing experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of construction contracts, change management, subcontract administration, and progress billing.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, OneNote, and Bluebeam Revu/Studio.
  • Experience with Procore document control and project management workflows.
  • Ability to navigate IFC detailing models using Trimble Connect.
  • Experience with Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 preferred.
  • Familiarity with Tekla or SDS2 is a plus.
  • Strong communication, organizational, leadership, and client service skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate effectively across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel for project meetings and jobsite visits, including overnight travel and periodic weekly site visits.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management preferred, but not required.

Benefits

  • Competitive annual compensation of $100,000–$150,000, based on experience.
  • Remote work flexibility with project-related travel.
  • Opportunity to manage complex structural and miscellaneous steel projects throughout the Western United States.
  • Collaboration with dedicated preconstruction, detailing, fabrication, purchasing, safety, and project administration teams.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of projects from detailing through fabrication, erection, and closeout.
  • Professional growth within an established structural steel contracting organization.
